metadata.title: Type changing, compact generalized Calabi--Yaus
metadata.abstract: We provide the first compact examples of type-changing generalized Calabi--Yau manifolds using Fei's construction of non-Kähler Calabi--Yau manifolds on branched covers of twistor spaces \cite{Fei16}. The structure, which is generically of type 1 and changes to type 3, is constructed on the product of a hyperelliptic surface of genus three and a four-torus, $\Sigma_3 \times \mathbb{T}^4$, with starting point a non-Kähler Calabi--Yau structure.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 变型广义 Calabi–Yau 紧例子
analysis.workSummary: 在亏格三超椭圆曲面与四维环面的乘积上，利用非 Kähler Calabi–Yau 背景构造类型由 1 变为 3 的广义 Calabi–Yau 结构。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出摘要所称首批紧致的变型广义 Calabi–Yau 例子。
analysis.limitations: 构造针对具体乘积及所用分支覆叠背景，不是一般存在或分类定理。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露大语言模型帮助找到 Fei 的构造并重现相关论证；构造路线此前已为作者等人所知。
